roles.summary: A single tiny uppercase row at the top: brand name left, site or co-brand right. Never larger than 1% of canvas height.
Footer column 1: company or show name in a medium title (about 2% canvas height) with a smaller subtitle line beneath.
Footer columns 2 and 3: three short lines each, sentence case, tight leading, aligned to the same baseline grid as column 1.
Inside the artifact, display type may be oversized (8-12% height) and is the only place scale drama is allowed.
